label: X6U IP phone
description: Fanvil X6U enterprise desk phone with a 4.3-inch main colour screen plus two 2.4-inch side screens, 20 SIP lines, dual Gigabit ports (network plus PC passthrough) and integrated 802.3af PoE.
notes: 'Dual Gigabit ports, integrated PoE', 10/100/1000 Mbps, 20 SIP lines, built-in Bluetooth, optional 5 V/2 A adapter. Fanvil does not publish a PoE class for the X6U; published dissipation is 1.49 W standby / 6.88 W high, which exceeds the 6.49 W class-2 PD cap, so this entry budgets class 3 (12.95 W) rather than under-powering it. EHS headset, RJ9 handset and the USB port are not modelled.
